Alice locks sompi. 1 unit = 1 locked sompi. No oracle.
Alice pays the merchant on the native rail. PoW sequences it.
Bob pays the merchant with USDT guest. Kaspa still sequences. The unit is Tether policy.
Issuer blacklists the merchant. Guest rail stops. Native rail does not notice.
Merchant redeems native sompi. Sponsor paid the fee. Principal intact.
Merchant tries to move the USDT. Issuer switch wins.
